description: Pay an OpenRouter Coinbase Payment Link with Stellar, Solana, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, Base (USDT/USDC) or Bitcoin Lightning. A bridge creates a one-time deposit order for the coin you actually hold, then a funder wallet settles the Coinbase invoice for you. Use when a payments.coinbase.com/payment-links/pl_* (or payment-sessions/paymentSession_*) URL should be paid with any of these coins, or on "rozo-checkout" / "pay this link with bitcoin".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
